description: Burial of Gln154 and Ser157 in LYS-1 compared with the true catalytic residues in LYS-6, to test whether their conservation can be attributed to core packing
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
BB={"N","CA","C","O","OXT"}
def load_pdb(fn):
    at={}; rn={}
    for ln in open(fn):
        if not ln.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        i=int(ln[22:26]); a=ln[12:16].strip()
        at.setdefault(i,{})[a]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
        rn[i]=ln[17:20]
    return at,rn
def sc(d):
    s=[v for k,v in d.items() if k not in BB]
    return s if s else [d["CA"]]
def burial(fn):
    at,rn=load_pdb(fn); cas={r:d["CA"] for r,d in at.items() if "CA" in d}
    nb={r:sum(1 for q,x in cas.items() if q!=r and np.linalg.norm(x-np.mean(sc(d),axis=0))<10.0)
        for r,d in at.items()}
    s=pd.Series(nb)
    return s, rn, s.median()

n1,rn1,m1=burial("AF-O62415.pdb"); n6,rn6,m6=burial("AF-Q20968.pdb")
print(f"AF-O62415 (LYS-1): median neighbour count {m1:.0f}   |   AF-Q20968 (LYS-6): median {m6:.0f}")
print("\nNeighbour count of the positions at issue (lower = more solvent exposed)")
rows=[]
for fn,nb,rn,med,items in [("LYS-1",n1,rn1,m1,[(64,"Asp64, catalytic Asp1 retained"),(154,"Gln154, replaces catalytic Asp2"),
                                               (157,"Ser157, replaces catalytic Glu"),(260,"Asp260, Asp64 partner"),(194,"Asp194")]),
                           ("LYS-6",n6,rn6,m6,[(22,"Asp22, catalytic Asp1"),(112,"Asp112, catalytic Asp2"),
                                               (114,"Glu114, catalytic Glu"),(209,"Asp209, Asp22 partner")])]:
    for p,lab in items:
        rows.append(dict(protein=fn,pos=p,res=rn[p],label=lab,neighbours=int(nb[p]),
                         pct_of_structure=round(float((nb<nb[p]).mean()*100),1),
                         status="exposed" if nb[p]<=med else "buried"))
B=pd.DataFrame(rows); B.to_csv("catalytic_position_burial.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",200); print(B.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,4))
for i,(nm,nb,med) in enumerate([("LYS-1",n1,m1),("LYS-6",n6,m6)]):
    v=nb.values
    ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i,0.07,len(v)),v,s=7,color="#bdbdbd",alpha=0.6,zorder=2)
    ax.hlines(med,i-0.3,i+0.3,color="#555555",lw=1.4)
sub=B[B.protein=="LYS-1"]
for _,r in sub.iterrows():
    c="#c0392b" if r.pos in (154,157) else "#1f6fb2"
    ax.scatter([0],[r.neighbours],color=c,s=42,zorder=5,edgecolor="white",lw=0.6)
    ax.annotate(f"{r.res}{r.pos}",(0,r.neighbours),xytext=(12,0),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8,color=c)
sub=B[B.protein=="LYS-6"]
for _,r in sub.iterrows():
    ax.scatter([1],[r.neighbours],color="#2a6f4e",s=42,zorder=5,edgecolor="white",lw=0.6)
    ax.annotate(f"{r.res}{r.pos}",(1,r.neighbours),xytext=(12,0),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8,color="#2a6f4e")
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["LYS-1 (O62415)","LYS-6 (Q20968)"])
ax.set_ylabel("neighbouring CA atoms within 10 A of side-chain centroid")
ax.set_title("Burial of the catalytic and substituted positions; grey line is each structure's median",loc="left",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
